question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "depth".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Shallowness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Depth" means the distance from the top to the bottom of something, or intensity/profoundness. (गहराई)
◦ Example: The depth of the ocean at that point exceeds ten kilometres.

 

• "Shallowness" means lack of depth, either physical or intellectual, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उथलापन)
◦ Example: The shallowness of the pond made it safe for children to play in.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Profundity (गहनता): Refers to great depth of intellect or feeling — a synonym of depth, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Immensity (विशालता): Means vastness or enormous size — related to depth in scale, not its opposite.

 

• Option 4: Vastness (विस्तार): Denotes great extent or scale — again close in meaning to depth, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of depth: profundity, intensity, deepness, richness, extent.

 

• Synonyms of shallowness: superficiality, triviality, flimsiness, thinness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ample (पर्याप्त): Scanty (अल्प), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

2. Brave (बहादुर): Cowardly (कायर), Timid (डरपोक)

3. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (छलपूर्ण)

4. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

5. Eager (उत्सुक): Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Indifferent (उदासीन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Generous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Stingy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Generous" means willing to give freely and share with others, especially money or time. (उदार)

 

• "Stingy" means unwilling to spend money or give freely, and practically reflects a miserly, tight-fisted attitude toward giving. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कंजूस)
◦ Example: The stingy landlord refused to fix even the smallest repairs.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Benevolent (परोपकारी) — kind and charitable in nature; a synonym of generous, not its opposite.

 

• Option 3: Charitable (दानशील) — inclined to give to those in need; close in meaning to generous.

 

• Option 4: Magnanimous (उदारचित्त) — noble and generous in spirit, especially toward a rival; again a synonym.

 

• Other antonyms of generous: miserly, tight-fisted, mean, selfish, ungenerous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

2. Genuine (वास्तविक): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

3. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

4. Just (न्यायपूर्ण): Unjust (अन्यायपूर्ण), Biased (पक्षपाती)

5. Keen (उत्सुक): Apathetic (उदासीन), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "active".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Passive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Active" means engaging in physical or mental activity; energetic and lively. (सक्रिय)
◦ Example: She remains active in local politics even after retirement.

 

• "Passive" means accepting or allowing what happens without active response or resistance, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निष्क्रिय)
◦ Example: He took a passive role in the discussion, simply listening without comment.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Energetic (ऊर्जावान): Full of energy and enthusiasm — a synonym of active, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Dynamic (गतिशील): Characterized by constant change or activity — close in meaning to active.

 

• Option 4: Vigorous (जोशीला): Strong, healthy, and full of energy — again a synonym of active.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of active: energetic, dynamic, vigorous, lively, animated.

 

• Synonyms of passive: inactive, inert, submissive, docile.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lenient (नरम): Strict (सख्त), Harsh (कठोर)

2. Meticulous (सूक्ष्मता से काम करने वाला): Careless (असावधान), Negligent (लापरवाह)

3. Novice (नौसिखिया): Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Veteran (अनुभवी)

4. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (अनुपालनशील)

5. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (उतावला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Departure."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Advent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Departure" means the act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey. (प्रस्थान)

 

• "Advent" means the arrival or coming of a notable event, person, or era, and practically marks the beginning rather than the end of something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आगमन)
◦ Example: The advent of the internet transformed how people communicate.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Exit (निकास) — the act of going out or leaving; a synonym of departure.

 

• Option 2: Withdrawal (वापसी) — the act of removing oneself from a place or situation; close in meaning to departure.

 

• Option 3: Exodus (पलायन) — a mass departure of people; again a synonym in sense.

 

• Other antonyms of departure: arrival, appearance, coming, entrance.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quaint (विचित्र आकर्षक): Ordinary (साधारण), Modern (आधुनिक)

2. Rigid (कठोर): Flexible (लचीला), Elastic (लचकदार)

3. Sparse (विरल): Dense (घना), Abundant (प्रचुर)

4. Tedious (उबाऊ): Interesting (रोचक), Exciting (रोमांचक)

5. Upright (ईमानदार): Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "giant".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Tiny.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Giant" means extremely large in size, extent, or degree. (विशाल)
◦ Example: A giant crane was used to lift the shipping containers.

 

• "Tiny" means very small in size, and is therefore the correct antonym. (नन्हा)
◦ Example: The tiny kitten could fit in the palm of her hand.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Enormous (विशाल): Extremely large in size or extent — a synonym of giant, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Massive (विशालकाय): Very large and heavy — close in meaning to giant.

 

• Option 4: Colossal (बहुत बड़ा): Extraordinarily large — again a synonym of giant.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of giant: huge, enormous, massive, colossal, gigantic.

 

• Synonyms of tiny: minute, minuscule, small, diminutive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vibrant (जीवंत): Dull (फीका), Lifeless (निर्जीव)

2. Wary (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

3. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Unenthusiastic (अनुत्साहित)

4. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

5. Bold (साहसी): Timid (डरपोक), Diffident (संकोची)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Concentrate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Disperse.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Concentrate" means to focus attention or gather something closely together in one place. (केंद्रित करना)

 

• "Disperse" means to spread or scatter over a wide area, and practically the opposite of gathering things into one place. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बिखेरना)
◦ Example: The police ordered the crowd to disperse after the rally ended.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Focus (केंद्रित करना) — to direct attention or effort toward a single point; a synonym of concentrate.

 

• Option 3: Converge (एकत्रित होना) — to come together from different directions toward one point; close in meaning to concentrate.

 

• Option 4: Centralize (केंद्रीकृत करना) — to bring under one central control or place; again a synonym in sense.

 

• Other antonyms of concentrate: scatter, spread, dissipate, distribute.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Coarse (खुरदरा): Smooth (चिकना), Fine (महीन)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Rebellious (विद्रोही), Unruly (उद्दंड)

3. Elaborate (विस्तृत): Simple (सरल), Plain (सादा)

4. Fragile (नाजुक): Sturdy (मजबूत), Durable (टिकाऊ)

5. Grim (निराशाजनक): Cheerful (प्रसन्नचित्त), Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "colorful".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Monochrome.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Colorful" means having or showing bright, varied colors. (रंगीन)
◦ Example: The festival was known for its colorful decorations and costumes.

 

• "Monochrome" means having or using only one color, or shades of a single color, and is therefore the correct antonym. (एकवर्णी)
◦ Example: The photographer preferred monochrome images over colored ones for their timeless feel.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Vivid (चटख): Producing powerful, clear colors or images — a synonym of colorful, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Bright (चमकीला): Giving out or reflecting a lot of light; vivid in color — close in meaning to colorful.

 

• Option 4: Radiant (चमकदार): Sending out light; glowing brightly — again related to colorful, not its opposite.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of colorful: vivid, vibrant, bright, radiant, gaudy.

 

• Synonyms of monochrome: colorless, black-and-white, achromatic, uncolored.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Hasty (जल्दबाज़): Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया), Careful (सावधान)

2. Immaculate (बेदाग़): Dirty (गंदा), Filthy (मैला)

3. Jovial (हंसमुख): Gloomy (उदास), Somber (गंभीर)

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

5. Nimble (फुर्तीला): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Sluggish (सुस्त)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Glanced."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Stared.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Glanced" means looked at something or someone briefly or quickly. (सरसरी नज़र डाली)

 

• "Stared" means looked fixedly or intently at something for a long time, and practically the opposite of a quick, passing look. It is therefore the correct antonym. (घूरा)
◦ Example: The children stared at the magician in wide-eyed wonder.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Peeked (झांका) — took a quick, often secretive look; a synonym of glanced, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Glimpsed (झलक देखी) — saw briefly or partially; close in meaning to glanced.

 

• Option 3: Skimmed (सरसरी तौर पर देखा) — looked over something quickly without close attention; again a synonym in sense.

 

• Other antonyms of glanced: stared, gazed, scrutinized, studied.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Opaque (अपारदर्शी): Transparent (पारदर्शी), Clear (साफ़)

2. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (उत्तेजित)

3. Robust (मजबूत): Feeble (कमजोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

4. Serene (शांत): Chaotic (अराजक), Stormy (तूफानी)

5. Tranquil (शांतिपूर्ण): Hectic (अफरातफरी भरा), Restless (बेचैन)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "depressed".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Cheerful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Depressed" means in a state of general unhappiness or despondency; sad and low in spirit. (उदास)
◦ Example: He felt depressed after failing the entrance exam.

 

• "Cheerful" means noticeably happy and optimistic, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रसन्नचित्त)
◦ Example: Despite the rain, she remained cheerful throughout the trip.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Gloomy (उदास): In low spirits; showing sadness — a synonym of depressed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Dejected (निराश): Sad and disappointed — close in meaning to depressed.

 

• Option 4: Downcast (हतोत्साहित): Feeling despondent or disheartened — again a synonym of depressed.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of depressed: sad, gloomy, dejected, downcast, despondent.

 

• Synonyms of cheerful: happy, jolly, joyful, upbeat.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र)

2. Blunt (स्पष्टवादी): Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Tactful (चतुराईपूर्ण)

3. Compact (सुसंहत): Bulky (भारी-भरकम), Spacious (विशाल)

4. Dexterous (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (अटपटा)

5. Earnest (निष्ठावान): Insincere (दिखावटी), Frivolous (तुच्छ)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Give back."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Keep.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Give back" means to return something to its original owner or place. (वापस करना)

 

• "Keep" means to retain possession of something and not give it up, and practically the opposite of returning it to someone else. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रखना)
◦ Example: You may keep the book as long as you need it.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Return (लौटाना) — to give something back to its owner; a synonym of give back.

 

• Option 3: Restore (पुनर्स्थापित करना) — to give back or bring back to a former state; close in meaning to give back.

 

• Option 4: Refund (धनवापसी करना) — to pay back money that was received; again a synonym in sense of giving back.

 

• Other antonyms of give back: keep, retain, withhold, hold onto.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Feeble (कमजोर): Strong (ताकतवर), Powerful (शक्तिशाली)

2. Genial (सौम्य): Aloof (अलग-थलग), Reserved (संकोची)

3. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

4. Intricate (जटिल): Simple (सरल), Straightforward (सीधा)

5. Jubilant (अत्यंत हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Mournful (शोकाकुल)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "dig".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Fill.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Dig" means to break up and remove earth, especially to make a hole. (खोदना)
◦ Example: Workers had to dig a deep trench to lay the new pipeline.

 

• "Fill" means to make something full by putting material into an empty space, and is therefore the correct antonym. (भरना)
◦ Example: They decided to fill the old well with soil and stones.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Excavate (खोदना): To dig out and remove earth carefully, often to reveal something — a synonym of dig, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Burrow (बिल बनाना): To dig a hole or tunnel, especially as an animal's home — close in meaning to dig.

 

• Option 4: Delve (गहराई से खोदना): To dig or search deeply into something — again a synonym of dig.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of dig: excavate, burrow, delve, scoop, unearth.

 

• Synonyms of fill: stuff, pack, load, top up.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lofty (अत्यंत ऊँचा): Modest (विनम्र), Lowly (निम्न)

2. Meager (अल्प): Ample (पर्याप्त), Copious (प्रचुर)

3. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Shrewd (चतुर)

4. Opulent (समृद्ध): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

5. Pristine (अछूता): Contaminated (दूषित), Polluted (प्रदूषित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Get back."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Lose.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Get back" means to obtain again something that was lost, taken away, or given to someone else. (वापस पाना)

 

• "Lose" means to no longer have something because it has been taken away, misplaced, or destroyed, and practically the opposite of recovering it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (खोना)
◦ Example: He was careless and tended to lose his belongings frequently.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Recover (पुनः प्राप्त करना) — to get back something lost or taken; a synonym of get back.

 

• Option 2: Regain (फिर से पाना) — to obtain possession of something again; close in meaning to get back.

 

• Option 3: Retrieve (वापस लाना) — to get or bring something back, especially from a difficult place; again a synonym in sense.

 

• Other antonyms of get back: lose, forfeit, surrender, relinquish.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rustic (ग्रामीण): Urban (शहरी), Sophisticated (परिष्कृत)

2. Solemn (गंभीर): Playful (चंचल), Lighthearted (हल्के-फुल्के मिजाज़ का)

3. Trivial (तुच्छ): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Crucial (अहम)

4. Urbane (सुसंस्कृत): Boorish (असभ्य), Uncouth (अशिष्ट)

5. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Constant (अपरिवर्तनशील)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "cosy".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Uncomfortable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Cosy" means giving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation. (आरामदायक)
◦ Example: They spent the evening in a cosy little cottage by the fire.

 

• "Uncomfortable" means causing or feeling physical discomfort or unease, and is therefore the correct antonym. (असुविधाजनक)
◦ Example: The hard wooden bench was uncomfortable to sit on for long.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Snug (आरामदायक): Warm, comfortable, and cosy in a close-fitting way — a synonym of cosy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Comfortable (सुविधाजनक): Providing physical ease and relaxation — close in meaning to cosy.

 

• Option 4: Relaxing (आरामदेह): Helping to reduce tension and rest the mind or body — again a synonym of cosy.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of cosy: snug, comfortable, warm, homely, relaxing.

 

• Synonyms of uncomfortable: uneasy, awkward, unpleasant, distressing.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Wane (घटना): Wax (बढ़ना), Increase (वृद्धि होना)

2. Vague (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

3. Wistful (तड़प भरा): Content (संतुष्ट), Untroubled (निश्चिंत)

4. Austere (सादा): Luxurious (विलासी), Indulgent (भोगविलासी)

5. Bleak (निराशाजनक): Promising (आशाजनक), Hopeful (आशावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Go on."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Stop.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Go on" means to continue happening or doing something without stopping. (जारी रहना)

 

• "Stop" means to cease moving or acting, and figuratively/practically brings an activity to a complete halt. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रुकना)
◦ Example: The music suddenly stopped in the middle of the song.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Continue (जारी रखना) — to keep happening or doing something without interruption; a synonym of 'go on', not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Proceed (आगे बढ़ना) — to move forward or carry on with an action; a synonym of 'go on', not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Persist (डटे रहना) — to continue firmly in a course of action despite difficulty; a synonym of 'go on', not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of go on: stop, cease, halt, pause, discontinue.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (छिटपुट): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Meager (अल्प)

3. Benevolent (दयालु): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

4. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (छलपूर्ण)

5. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "destruction".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Preservation.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Destruction" means the act of destroying or ruining something completely. (विनाश)
◦ Example: The earthquake caused widespread destruction across the city.

 

• "Preservation" means the act of keeping something safe or protecting it from harm, decay, or destruction, and is therefore the correct antonym. (संरक्षण)
◦ Example: Wildlife preservation is essential for maintaining biodiversity.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Devastation (विनाश): Severe and widespread destruction — a synonym of destruction, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Demolition (विध्वंस): The deliberate pulling down or destruction of a building or structure — a synonym of destruction, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Ruin (बर्बादी): The state of being severely damaged or destroyed — a synonym of destruction, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of destruction: devastation, demolition, ruin, havoc, annihilation.

 

• Synonyms of preservation: conservation, protection, maintenance, safeguarding.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट भाषी), Tongue-tied (बोलने में असमर्थ)

2. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

3. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Solitary (एकांतप्रिय)

4. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

5. Immense (विशाल): Tiny (नन्हा), Minute (सूक्ष्म)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Immigration."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Emigration.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Immigration" means the act of coming to live permanently in a foreign country. (आप्रवासन)

 

• "Emigration" means the act of leaving one's own country to settle permanently in another, and figuratively/practically represents movement in the opposite direction to immigration. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्प्रवासन)
◦ Example: Emigration from the war-torn region increased sharply last year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Arrival (आगमन) — the act of reaching or entering a place; a synonym in the sense of coming in, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Settlement (बसावट) — the act of settling permanently in a new place; a synonym of the idea of immigrating, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Migration (प्रवासन) — the general movement of people from one place to another; closely related to immigration, not its antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of immigration: emigration, exodus, departure, outmigration.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jovial (प्रसन्नचित्त): Gloomy (उदास), Somber (गंभीर)

2. Kindle (प्रज्वलित करना): Extinguish (बुझाना), Douse (पानी डालकर बुझाना)

3. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

4. Meticulous (सावधानीपूर्ण): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (अस्तव्यस्त)

5. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (सांसारिक ज्ञान वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "strange".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Familiar.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Strange" means unusual, unfamiliar, or difficult to understand. (अजीब)
◦ Example: She heard a strange noise coming from the attic.

 

• "Familiar" means well known, easily recognized, or commonly experienced, and is therefore the correct antonym. (परिचित)
◦ Example: The old song sounded familiar to him.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Odd (अजीब): Unusual or unexpected — a synonym of strange, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Peculiar (विचित्र): Strange or unusual in a distinctive way — a synonym of strange, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Unusual (असामान्य): Not habitually or commonly occurring — a synonym of strange, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of strange: odd, peculiar, unusual, unfamiliar, bizarre.

 

• Synonyms of familiar: well-known, recognizable, common, accustomed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

2. Petty (क्षुद्र): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Major (प्रमुख)

3. Quaint (पुराने ढंग का): Modern (आधुनिक), Fashionable (फैशनेबल)

4. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Willing (इच्छुक), Eager (उत्सुक)

5. Scarce (दुर्लभ): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Enquired."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Answered.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Enquired" means asked for information about something. (पूछताछ की)

 

• "Answered" means gave a response to a question, and figuratively/practically provides the information that was sought rather than asking for it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्तर दिया)
◦ Example: She answered every question the interviewer asked.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Asked (पूछा) — requested information from someone; a synonym of enquired, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Questioned (सवाल किया) — asked questions of someone, often in detail; a synonym of enquired, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Queried (जिज्ञासा प्रकट की) — asked a question, often to clear a doubt; a synonym of enquired, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of enquired: answered, replied, responded, retorted.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Brave (बहादुर)

2. Utter (पूर्ण): Partial (आंशिक), Incomplete (अपूर्ण)

3. Vague (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

4. Wane (क्षीण होना): Wax (बढ़ना), Increase (वृद्धि होना)

5. Yield (समर्पण करना): Resist (विरोध करना), Withstand (झेलना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "delicious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Distasteful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Delicious" means very pleasant to taste or smell. (स्वादिष्ट)
◦ Example: The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.

 

• "Distasteful" means unpleasant to taste, or otherwise disagreeable and offensive, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अरुचिकर)
◦ Example: He found the bitter medicine quite distasteful.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Tasty (स्वादिष्ट): Having a pleasant, strong flavour — a synonym of delicious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Delectable (लज़ीज़): Extremely delicious and delightful to taste — a synonym of delicious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Scrumptious (बहुत स्वादिष्ट): Extremely tasty and appetizing — a synonym of delicious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of delicious: tasty, delectable, scrumptious, savoury, appetizing.

 

• Synonyms of distasteful: unpleasant, disagreeable, unpalatable, offensive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (उपेक्षाशील)

2. Ample (पर्याप्त): Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Scant (नाकाफी)

3. Bleak (निराशाजनक): Promising (आशाजनक), Cheerful (हर्षित)

4. Coarse (खुरदरा): Smooth (चिकना), Fine (महीन)

5. Docile (विनम्र): Unruly (उद्दंड), Stubborn (जिद्दी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Hardly ever."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Frequently.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Hardly ever" means almost never or very rarely. (शायद ही कभी)

 

• "Frequently" means happening often or at regular short intervals, and figuratively/practically describes something occurring quite the opposite of rarely. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अक्सर)
◦ Example: He frequently visits his grandparents on weekends.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Rarely (शायद ही कभी) — not often; a synonym of hardly ever, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Seldom (कभी-कभार) — not often, infrequently; a synonym of hardly ever, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Scarcely (मुश्किल से) — barely or almost not at all; a synonym of hardly ever, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of hardly ever: frequently, often, regularly, always.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Extol (प्रशंसा करना): Criticize (आलोचना करना), Denounce (निंदा करना)

2. Feeble (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Powerful (शक्तिशाली)

3. Genuine (असली): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

4. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

5. Immaculate (बेदाग): Dirty (गंदा), Filthy (अत्यंत गंदा)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "delay".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Hasten.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Delay" means to make something happen or arrive later than expected. (देरी करना)
◦ Example: Heavy traffic delayed the flight by two hours.

 

• "Hasten" means to hurry or speed up the occurrence of something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (जल्दी करना)
◦ Example: She hastened her steps to catch the train.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Postpone (स्थगित करना): To put off an event to a later time — a synonym of delay, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Defer (टालना): To put off action or consideration to a later time — a synonym of delay, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Procrastinate (टालमटोल करना): To delay or postpone action, often habitually — a synonym of delay, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of delay: postpone, defer, procrastinate, stall, retard.

 

• Synonyms of hasten: hurry, speed up, quicken, expedite.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jubilant (उल्लासित): Dejected (निराश), Sad (उदास)

2. Keen (उत्सुक): Uninterested (अरुचि रखने वाला), Indifferent (उदासीन)

3. Lenient (उदार): Strict (कठोर), Harsh (रूखा)

4. Mundane (नीरस): Extraordinary (असाधारण), Exciting (रोमांचक)

5. Notorious (कुख्यात): Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Esteemed (सम्मानित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Incredible."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Ordinary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incredible" means impossible or very hard to believe; extraordinary. (अविश्वसनीय)

 

• "Ordinary" means commonplace and unremarkable, and figuratively/practically has nothing extraordinary or hard to believe about it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (साधारण)
◦ Example: It was just an ordinary day at the office.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Amazing (अद्भुत) — causing great surprise or wonder; a synonym of incredible, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Extraordinary (असाधारण) — very unusual or remarkable; a synonym of incredible, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Astonishing (चौंका देने वाला) — extremely surprising or impressive; a synonym of incredible, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of incredible: ordinary, common, believable, unremarkable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Opulent (विलासितापूर्ण): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (दरिद्र)

2. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (उतावला)

3. Quell (दबाना): Incite (भड़काना), Provoke (उकसाना)

4. Robust (सुदृढ़): Weak (कमजोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

5. Solemn (गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Playful (चंचल)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "angry".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Serene.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Angry" means feeling or showing strong displeasure or hostility. (क्रोधित)
◦ Example: He was angry when he found out about the mistake.

 

• "Serene" means calm, peaceful, and untroubled, and is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)
◦ Example: The lake looked serene in the early morning light.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Furious (अत्यंत क्रोधित): Extremely angry — a synonym of angry, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Irate (क्रोधित): Feeling or showing anger — a synonym of angry, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Enraged (क्रोधोन्मत्त): Made very angry; furious — a synonym of angry, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of angry: furious, irate, enraged, indignant, incensed.

 

• Synonyms of serene: calm, peaceful, tranquil, placid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tedious (थकाऊ): Interesting (रोचक), Exciting (रोमांचक)

2. Upright (ईमानदार): Dishonest (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट)

3. Vivid (जीवंत): Dull (फीका), Faded (मलिन)

4. Wither (मुरझाना): Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Bloom (खिलना)

5. Yearn (तरसना): Loathe (घृणा करना), Dislike (नापसंद करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Former."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Current.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Former" means having previously held a position or existed at an earlier time; previous. (भूतपूर्व)

 

• "Current" means belonging to the present time, and figuratively/practically refers to what exists now rather than what existed before. It is therefore the correct antonym. (वर्तमान)
◦ Example: The current president addressed the nation yesterday.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Previous (पिछला) — existing or occurring before the time mentioned; a synonym of former, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Past (बीता हुआ) — gone by in time; a synonym of former, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Earlier (पहले का) — happening before the present time; a synonym of former, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of former: current, present, latter, existing.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Zenith (शिखर): Nadir (निम्नतम बिंदु), Bottom (तल)

2. Abrupt (अचानक): Gradual (क्रमिक), Slow (धीमा)

3. Blunt (कुंद): Sharp (तेज़), Pointed (नुकीला)

4. Compassionate (दयालु): Ruthless (निर्दयी), Merciless (निर्मम)

5. Dubious (संदिग्ध): Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "damaged".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Flawless.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Damaged" means harmed, broken, or impaired in some way. (क्षतिग्रस्त)
◦ Example: The storm damaged several houses along the coast.

 

• "Flawless" means without any imperfection or defect; perfect, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निर्दोष)
◦ Example: She gave a flawless performance at the concert.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Broken (टूटा हुआ): Damaged so as to be unable to function; not whole — a synonym of damaged, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Impaired (दुर्बल): Weakened or damaged in function or structure — a synonym of damaged, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Defective (त्रुटिपूर्ण): Having a fault or imperfection — a synonym of damaged, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of damaged: broken, impaired, defective, harmed, spoiled.

 

• Synonyms of flawless: perfect, faultless, impeccable, immaculate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Elated (अति प्रसन्न): Depressed (अवसादग्रस्त), Dejected (निराश)

2. Fickle (चंचल): Constant (स्थिर), Steadfast (दृढ़)

3. Grim (कठोर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Haughty (घमंडी): Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनयशील)

5. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Calm (शांत)
